subject: prd/tech-design-brainstorm
statement: When grilling exposes a defect in the requirement basis — a missing requirement, a contradiction, an unstated non-goal — the skill shall stop designing, record the gap with its basis anchors, and gate the session `needs-more-product` naming the `/prd-amend` route; the skill shall never adjust, reinterpret, or design around the requirement content.
rationale: product/design drift enters through silent patches; the bounce is the formal exit (#D-5)
fit_criterion: on hole-seeded fixtures, zero silent patches: the gap is recorded with anchors and the session gates needs-more-product; the negative fixture (a run that designs around the hole) is an EVAL-4 failure
